claim: When a bundler inlines prefixed env vars (VITE_*, NEXT_PUBLIC_*), a credential referenced anywhere in client code ships in every build that compiles that code, even behind a runtime branch; blank it at build time per target and fail the deploy if its value appears in the output.
because: Distill's App Check debug token, read only in extension/dev branches, was found inlined in the hosted web bundle before the first deploy; a define + a dist scan (falsified by planting the token) closed it.

claim: When an SDK's default request timeout is longer than a person will watch a spinner (Firebase AI Logic: 180 s), set an explicit timeout sized from the measured healthy latency and pair it with one retry for overload/5xx, so a transient overload becomes a fallback instead of a frozen screen.
because: A 'high demand' 500 left a live wizard loading for over a minute; healthy calls measured 3-8 s; a 25 s timeout + one retry restored the fallback path.

claim: When content is extracted from a DOM for a model, skip every control and editable region (input, textarea, select, contenteditable, role=textbox) everywhere, not only inside forms, because what a person types is a value, not page content.
because: bp's adoption judgement found contenteditable text outside a <form> reaching Distill's cloud-eligible page prompts; a test typing into an editor on a form-less page failed before the fix and passes after.

claim: When a wizard writes its answers into a form it does not own, read each step's fields on entry and write only fields whose answer differs from what the target holds, compared by the same acceptance rule the write uses, because a blind write of the whole step erases values that arrived after the wizard last read the form.
because: Wayfill sent an empty string for every untouched field of a step, clearing values typed in the original, accepted agent answers, and page values after Forget; and a single-box render of a tick group unticked the others. Fixed with sameAnswer and a read on step entry, proved by 6 component tests that failed before.
